description:
Please Join Gwinnett Business Leaders and Elected Officials supporting Representative Farooq Mughal in his re-election campaign in 2024.

The Host Committee

  • Gwinnett County Commissioner Kirkland Carden
  • State Rep. Pedro Marin
  • Former State Senator Curt Thompson
  • City of Suwanee Mayor Pro Temp Linnea Miller
  • Imran Niazi

  • Chair - $3000
  • Sponsor - $2000
  • Patron - $1,000
  • Supporter - $500
  • Guest - $250

Contributions may be made online or by check at the event for Mughal for Georgia.

Honorable Georgia State Representative Farooq Mughal proudly represents the people of Georgia’s 105th District representing the Mall of Georgia, the city of Dacula, and parts of Lawrenceville. Representative Mughal is one of the top rising star lawmakers in Georgia. In his first legislative term, Governor Brian Kemp signed Representative Mughal’s ten co-sponsored legislation into law; focusing on veterans, law enforcement, criminal justice reform, addressing key workforce needs, and small business owners. He received an A+ ranking from the Georgia Chamber, Georgia Alliance Education Fund, New Georgia Project, Georgia Value Action, SPLC Action Fund, Poder Latinx, Equality Foundation, and The Peoples' Agenda.

Paid by Mughal for Georgia, LLC
